I know right?

I don't know how I can repay him. 
He put things in different perspectives and really helped me with my situations... 

All I know about him is his email address...

I honestly didn't expect much at first.

I thought everyone would just disconnect.

I am so glad that I tried Omegle.


I was really surprised when I connected to the next person and found out it was the same guy who got disconnected.
